The following seven readings are divided between students and will be presented in class. Choose an article from the list (we are aiming for two students per article). The goal is to introduce the new tools/innovations to the class (no slides). 8â10 min. of presentation followed by Q&A.Â 

Questions to cover:Â 

  • What problem does the article address?
  • What innovationâconceptual, methodological, etc.âdoes it offer?
  • How does using this new tool/approach (might) change our understanding of political phenomena?
  • Do you find the proposed tool/concept/approach useful? How/when do you see yourself using this tool?
  • What issues remain unresolved (in the research area that this tool is speaking to)?
